olivia: Heads-up  canary for cormorant-nano-q2 (int2 quant probe) shows a small persistent class of schema parse rejects on tool-invoke endpoints (~0.27%). dash: https://dash.internal/runs/5067
ben: any sample payloads?
li: captured a few failed streams. interesting pattern: an ANSI control sequence (ESC[...m) used for colored debug got emitted into a tool JSON field and sometimes gets split across stream chunks, e.g. `...\"status\": \"ok\"\x1b[3` then next chunk `4m\" }` -> parser rejects because control bytes appear unescaped in JSON string.
olivia: repro: stream=true + kv-cache + ~850 token context. ci-bot attached simple repro curl:
ci-bot: ```bash
curl -s -X POST https://canary.internal/invoke \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $CANARY' \
  -d '{"model":"cormorant-nano-q2","stream":true,"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"long chat..."}],"tools":[{"id":"log_write","schema":{}}]}'
```
ben: hmm ANSI escape sequences shouldn't appear in production payloads. which codepath emits them?
li: looks like a recent debug formatter in the tokenizer pipeline injects colorized spans for trace logging. kernel only supposed to emit that to console, but in fallback path we accidentally routed formatted tokens into the stream buffer. when chunk split happens it produces invalid-in-string raw bytes.
olivia: client-side mitigation you tried?
li: quick client fix: strip C0/C1 control ranges and ANSI CSI sequences before parse. snippet I used in python:
```
import re
clean = re.sub(r"\x1b\[[0-9;]*[mK]", "", raw)
clean = ''.join(ch for ch in clean if ord(ch) >= 32)
```
works for these samples but feels like a patch.
ben: infra plan: (A) runtime pre-parse sanitizer behind ff to strip known ANSI sequences and nonprintables (B) kernel: eliminate colorized debug formatter from any codepath that writes to streaming buffers (C) platform: ensure retry policy does not re-run side-effecting tools on 4xx parse errors (D) eng-ml: add fuzz tests that inject ANSI bytes at all chunk offsets to ensure sanitizer holds.
olivia: also noticed retries caused duplicate tool effects for one Dedicated tenant (ops-bot flagged). ops-bot: tenant = horizon-data, saw duplicate log entries (2 occurrences).
ops-bot: recommend rolling back client-side retry for 400 parse errors and adding idempotency_key to tool API for side-effecting operations.
ben: agree. we'll change retry policy to only retry on network/timeouts/5xx. li: can you add an idempotency param proposal?
li: drafting idempotency_key RFC and a short migration doc for SDKs. will post shortly.
ci-bot: added a job: https://ci.internal/job/5067/ansi-chunk-fuzz (generates chunks with ANSI splits at random offsets)
deploy-bot: scheduled canary: runtime-ansi-sanitize-v1 -> cormorant cluster at 5067890180 rolling 5% -> 100% in 10m if green
olivia: action items: (1) kernel patch to disable color formatter in stream writes (ben) (2) runtime sanitizer behind ff (ben) (3) eng-ml tests + fuzz (li) (4) platform retry policy update + idempotency RFC (olivia + product) (5) notify affected dedicated tenant and check SLA surface (ops-bot)
ben: PRs incoming: kernel: https://git.internal/infra/kernels/pull/312 (WIP) runtime: https://git.internal/infra/runtime/pull/415 (ff gated) tests: https://git.internal/eng-ml/stream-tests/pull/131
li: RFC draft: https://docs.internal/rfcs/idempotency-tool-keys (WIP)
olivia: thanks all  keeping this thread as the single source for coordination. ping me @olivia for canary traces or tenant contact.
